name: Domino Affiliate Program Manager
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Domino Affiliate Program Manager is a lightweight, easy-to-use affiliate program manager for WordPress. Keep track of your affiliates and their performance directly from your dashboard.

This initial release establishes the foundation for upcoming advanced features, providing a clean and secure start point.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/domino-affiliate-program-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Domino Affiliate’ menu in the dashboard to access the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, Domino Affiliate Program Manager is completely free to use.
